also: I don’t know what to do
what do you want me to do?

evidence: Traupman 61: Quid faciam nesciō., I don’t know what to do
terms.comment: A question about what to do puts the verb in the subjunctive. After nesciō it stays so, as an indirect question: quid faciam nesciō.

phrases.english: what do you want me to do?
I don’t know what to do.
